# Acceptance Criteria

Rules:

- Criteria lines use the exact format `- ACn: <criterion>`.

## Criteria

- AC1: The parser reads `flow.json` and survives [odd] brackets. [verify: exec `bun test x`]
- AC2: Plain criterion without a tag at all.
- AC3: Judged by a human. [verify: judged]
- AC4: Not testable. [verify: none — not testable]
